# REQ-0001: Users must be able to log in with OAuth

## Context

Customers have repeatedly asked for SSO. This unblocks enterprise sales.

## Acceptance criteria

- Google OAuth provider integrated
- GitHub OAuth provider integrated
- Session token rotation tested under load

## Open questions

- Does the SSO redirect need to support deep-linking back to the originally requested page?
